# Pocket City engine (vendored)

The files the build needs from April Zhu's Pocket City skill (https://april-zhu.com/pocketcity/), MIT licence (see
`LICENSE`): `scripts/build.py`, `scripts/render.mjs`, `assets/kit/`, `assets/template.html` and `assets/page.js`,
copied unchanged so that the page builds the same way everywhere, including on GitHub Actions.

To update: copy the same files from a newer skill install, rebuild, and check the renders before committing.
